subject.title: Feature: Activity-based heartbeat with idle timeout

question: What public heartbeat activity/idle contract should OpenClaw support for pausing scheduled heartbeats after user inactivity?
rationale: The fix adds public config and changes heartbeat scheduling semantics, so code inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the durable product contract or upgrade behavior.

options.title: Approve an activity idle-timeout key
options.body: Add a canonical heartbeat config key that gates scheduled interval heartbeats on recent real user/channel activity while preserving manual and event-backed wakes where appropriate.

options.title: Fold this into a broader heartbeat safety policy
options.body: Defer this issue to a larger heartbeat cost/backoff/zombie-session policy that also handles repeated provider errors and spend caps.

options.title: Keep existing primitives only
options.body: Decline a new config key and rely on activeHours, isolatedSession, lightContext, skipWhenBusy, missing/empty HEARTBEAT.md behavior, and manual disablement.

recommendation.title: Approve an activity idle-timeout key
recommendation.body: Add a canonical heartbeat config key that gates scheduled interval heartbeats on recent real user/channel activity while preserving manual and event-backed wakes where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior maintainer review context for this issue and has recent heartbeat config/runtime/docs history.
